comparisons.peer_summary: Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million in fiscal year 2024 and $244 million in fiscal year 2023. The 2024 charges primarily consisted of employee termination costs related to cost reduction activities associated with the VMware Merger, while the 2023 charges were primarily non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.
comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and AVGO report significant 'restructuring and other charges' that constitute a major component of their non-operating or other expenses in fiscal 2024, though the magnitude and primary drivers differ. QCOM reports $179 million in such charges, a significant decrease from $862 million in 2023, which were primarily restructuring-related. In contrast, AVGO's restructuring and other charges increased sharply to $1,533 million in 2024 from $244 million in 2023, driven specifically by employee termination costs related to the VMware Merger, whereas AVGO's 2023 charges were largely due to IP litigation.

sentences.text: • We recorded other expenses of $179 million in fiscal 2024 compared to $862 million in fiscal 2023, both of which primarily consisted of restructuring and restructuring-related charges.
Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million and $244 million in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
The fiscal year 2024 charges primarily included employee termination costs from cost reduction activities related to the VMware Merger.
